jobs.title: Copy of Clinical Implementation Manager  (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Company overview Mindpeak is building cutting-edge AI technology to transform cancer diagnostics for the better. Our AI-powered software is already in clinical use across more than 25 countries, helping pathologists assess tumour tissue faster, more accurately, and more consistently. Every year, tens of thousands of cancer patients already benefit from quicker and more accurate diagnoses enabled by our technology. Our mission is to scale this impact worldwide and help make personalised, effective cancer treatment accessible to every patient no matter where they are. By combining state-of-the-art AI with real-world clinical impact, we're working toward a future where every cancer patient gets the best possible diagnosis and, ultimately, the best possible care. The role Laboratories are digitising fast, and demand for our diagnostic AI has outgrown the way we deliver it. Every new lab is a project with many moving parts: our software is connected to the lab's image management and information systems, our AI is calibrated and validated on their cases, pathologists are trained, and the requirements of their market and accreditors are met. Each project brings together lab directors, pathologists and IT on the customer side, scanner and software partners, and our product, ML, engineering and quality teams internally. Usually several of these projects run at the same time and compete for the same people. As Clinical Implementation Manager you own the delivery of these projects, from signed contract to routine clinical use. You set the plan, direct the specialists who do the technical work, make the trade-offs when projects compete, and carry the go-live date. From day one you own around 10 lab customers in parallel, from smaller labs to important accounts, without needing someone to tell you what to do next. This is a senior delivery role. jobs.description: Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases. GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development. We operate as a private, profit-with-purpose company, channeling our commercial success back into scientific research, technology, and our people. With approximately 700 people across multiple countries and three service lines, we are growing deliberately, and the capability of our leaders and our organization is central to how we get there. If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you! Job Overview As a Clinical Database Programmer (internally referred to as Database Programmer ), you will support the development, testing and maintenance of Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems used in clinical trials. Working within a collaborative and innovative technical team, you will be involved in building clinical studies, developing electronic Case Report Forms (eCRFs), configuring edit checks and supporting data integrations, primarily using Medidata Rave. You will also have opportunities to contribute to new initiatives, explore AI-driven solutions and support continuous improvements in study development and operational efficiency. Key Responsibilities Design, build, test and maintain clinical study databases within EDC systems. Develop and configure eCRFs, edit checks and study-specific database requirements. Support clinical data transfers, integrations and database validation activities. Troubleshoot technical issues and provide ongoing EDC study support. Collaborate with Data Management, project teams and sponsors to ensure successful study delivery. Contribute to process improvements, automation and innovative solutions, including the use of AI. jobs.description: Office requirement : Hybrid, 1 day a week Employment type : Fixed-term contract – 9 months (Caregiver Leave Cover) At GWI we’re always looking for extraordinary people who thrive on making an extraordinary impact. Right now we’re looking for a  Senior Research Analyst to play a key role in our Research Services – Agency team in London, on a 9-month fixed-term contract covering parental leave. If that’s you, and making a difference gets you out of bed in the morning, keep reading. It could be the start of something, well, extraordinary. As our Senior Research Analyst, you’ll: As our Senior Research Analyst you’ll lead in the management of projects during all stages of the research process (client kick off, survey design to reporting), working across a range of research approaches. Our Senior Analysts are the face of our research, and working directly with research partners and clients is integral to the role. You’ll be doing that for the agency world. Our clients are global agency networks and independent agencies, and no two projects look the same: at one end, large and complex multi-market trackers; at the other, fast-turnaround one-off studies. The subject matter moves around just as much, so you’ll be getting up to speed on unfamiliar categories quickly and switching between them at pace. Variety is the spice of life, and this role has plenty of it. It’s also fun; shaking things up is what working for a growing company is all about. So you’ll need to be flexible, comfortable with continuous change, and working in a high-tempo environment as we grow. jobs.title: RWE Biostatistician
jobs.description: 🏨 The company Resilience Care is a leading French remote patient monitoring (RPM) company and a clinical research partner, founded in 2021 with a mission: better care. We provide RPM solutions in oncology, gastroenterology and psychiatry, combining ePRO collection with AI techniques. Our platform supports healthcare professionals with early side‑effect detection for continuous and proactive care, and our patient mobile app helps measure and manage symptoms with tailored resources. Our solutions improve care pathways, enrich continuous patient understanding, and accelerate clinical research through the collection, structuring and in‑depth analysis of real‑world data. They are currently deployed in routine care for 35,000 patients across 200+ healthcare institutions, and also support around twenty academic and industry clinical studies. We put data at the service of care and therapeutic innovation, with the ambition to enable every patient to benefit from personalized medicine. 📝 Your role In a nutshell : you will help build and deliver robust statistical work for Real‑World Evidence (RWE) and Medical Affairs studies — from analysis planning (SAP) to reproducible programming and clear interpretation. Your impact : make study execution more reliable, faster and more reproducible (plans, code and reporting), enabling cross‑functional teams to make informed decisions. Your day‑to‑day Draft and/or contribute to Statistical Analysis Plans (SAP) and methodological documentation. Program analyses in R and Python; concept of SQL/Postgre. Contribute to RWE studies : design, methods and execution. Set up data quality checks (consistency, cohort rules) and document assumptions. Produce decision‑ready deliverables (tables/figures/reporting) and explain results to non‑statisticians (internal or external actors). ✨ Your team Your future teammates : Dynamic team with medical and pharma expertise Your manager : Nicoleta - Director Translational Research – RWE & Biostatistics 👤 Pro

The CDM works on multi-functional teams and supports clinical trial projects as a departmental subject matter expert (SME). We are seeking a temporary clinical data manager who can dedicate 20 hours a week to support ongoing study activities.
